tools.name: search_carriers
tools.description: Find US motor carriers, brokers and freight forwarders by company name in FMCSA census data. Returns up to 10 matches with USDOT number, location and status.

tools.name: get_carrier
tools.description: Company record for one carrier by USDOT, MC, FF or MX number: census registration, operating authority, current insurance filings and 24-month roadside safety summary, with a CarrierTrail link.

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Changes to one carrier's public FMCSA census fields seen in the last 90 days (name, status, fleet size, MCS-150 date, dockets and more).
